description.value: The study examined anticipatory somatosensory activity during fear conditioning and its relationships with trait anxiety, auditory and amygdala activity, and functional connectivity.

spans.text: As our main interests were how somatosensory processing during fear conditioning is modulated by trait anxiety during the perceptual processing and disambiguation of conditioned stimuli, and how such multisensory information is integrated

design.value: A within-subject fear-conditioning fMRI study with CS+ and CS− tones, individual-differences correlations, mediation analysis, and beta-series functional connectivity analysis.

task_description.value: Participants heard low- or high-pitched tones; one tone was paired with electric shock, and they discriminated tone pitch by button press.

spans.text: Participants were then presented with one of the CS tones for 0.7 s, followed by a 1.2 s inter-stimulus interval.
